cause_definitions.tie-breaking among identical runs: same-file exact branch; at least two raw-equal runs
cause_definitions.whitespace normalisation: same-file exact branch without two raw-equal runs; normalized/raw ambiguity
cause_definitions.local-window similarity: local fuzzy branch wins at wrong location or for gone target
cause_definitions.cross-file ordering: cross-file exact branch selects wrong file/start or resurrects gone target
cause_definitions.other: unmatched residual, including no-match after full cascade
